shortDescription: Updates the configuration of agents associated with a specific scanner.

options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: scanner_id
options.description: The id of the scanner to get details from. Use the list_scanners module to get the id.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: software_update
options.description: The expiration time for agents, in days. If an agent has not communicated in this number of days, it will be considered expired and auto-unlinked if auto_unlink.enabled is true Valid values are 1-365.
